vendor_authority_note: The handbook states the authoritative list for a given gateway and key is the artek-mcp://tools resource, or the client's tool list. This extract is from the public handbook, not a live tools/list.
general_rules_quoted_or_paraphrased: Tools marked mutating are refused while readOnly is on (the default) and are then limited by the mutation allowlist.
Every mutating tool accepts dryRun: true.
The profile is a property of the credential, not the request.
A key with no profile is not narrowed.

gateway.name: opc_connections_list
gateway.purpose: OPC connection name, type, state and fault (no endpoint URLs)

gateway.name: system_metrics
gateway.purpose: JVM heap, threads, CPU and GC snapshot

gateway.name: loggers_list
gateway.purpose: which loggers exist and at what level

gateway.name: logger_level_set
gateway.purpose: set one logger's level, runtime only

gateway.name: redundancy_status
gateway.purpose: role, activity level, peer status and recovery mode

gateway.name: licenses_list
gateway.purpose: license state, including unlicensed or expired trials

projects.name: project_resource_write
projects.purpose: create or modify one resource file, validated before writing

config.name: config_resource_read
config.purpose: file list, attributes or content; secret fields are always redacted

config.name: config_manifest
config.purpose: per-resource SHA-256 digests for configuration drift checks

config.name: config_resource_write
config.purpose: create or modify one file; applies hot or after restart as the resource type requires; refuses content containing the redaction marker

tags.name: tag_config_read
tags.purpose: tag configuration, not values (up to 50 paths, recursive, localPropsOnly)

tags.name: udt_types_list
tags.purpose: UDT definitions in a provider's _types_ tree (up to 200)

tags.name: udt_definition_read
tags.purpose: one UDT definition's members and parameters

tags.name: tag_write
tags.purpose: up to 50 path and value pairs, with a quality result per path

historian.name: tag_history
historian.note: takes historian paths (histprov:), not tag paths

deploy_and_search_listed_on_same_page_pr.name: deploy_apply
deploy_and_search_listed_on_same_page_pr.note: rollback on failure; optional sha256 of the zip; does not validate script or JSON content the way project_resource_write does

tools.name: get_session_details
tools.note: authentication summary without tokens or raw IdP attributes

api.name: api_call
api.note: classified mutating for every method including GET; uses a configured Gateway API key sent as X-Ignition-API-Token over loopback

explicitly_absent_from_the_tags_table: No handbook tool named tag_config_write, tag_create, or udt_definition_write appears in the tags provider table reviewed on 2026-11-17.
tag_write is documented as writing path/value pairs with a quality result, i.e. values, not tag or UDT creation.
other_providers_not_fully_enumerated_on_: The handbook section 'Other providers' gives examples (user_remove, role_remove, storeforward_quarantine_delete, eam_task_update, export_diagnostics_bundle, audit log, alarm notification rosters) and points to separate pages for db, scripting, and api. This extract does not invent a complete 95-tool inventory.
Connect-a-client page also names diagnostics tools mcp_status and policy_explain.
